CAREERS AT KLIROLABSSTRATEGY / DESIGN / DEVELOPMENT

WHY THE WORK MATTERS

Curiosity meets craft.

Klirolabs works across custom websites, e-commerce experiences and software built around real business needs. The best work begins by understanding the people who will use it and the teams who will keep it running.

If you enjoy turning an unclear challenge into a clear plan, caring about the details and learning across design and engineering, we would like you to know what we do. Our team has offices in Bengaluru and the United States.

WHERE YOU COULD CONTRIBUTE

Different skills. Shared purpose.

Our work spans the thinking, design and engineering behind digital experiences.

OPEN OPPORTUNITIES

Find your next challenge.

Two opportunities to contribute to the websites, software and visual experiences we create.

01 / DEVELOPMENTOPEN ROLE

Junior Web Developer

Help build responsive websites and web experiences that are clear, accessible and dependable.

What you’ll work on

  • Develop and refine page layouts and interactive features with guidance from the team.
  • Turn designs into responsive interfaces and check them across screen sizes.
  • Help test, fix and improve performance, accessibility and usability.

What we’re looking for

  • A working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
  • Examples of websites or web projects you have built, including personal projects.
  • Curiosity, attention to detail and a willingness to learn from feedback.
Application details, work arrangement and compensation can be discussed directly.Apply by email ↗
02 / DESIGN INTERNSHIPOPEN ROLE

Graphic Design Intern

Create thoughtful visual work for digital experiences and help keep the Klirolabs brand clear and consistent.

What you’ll work on

  • Support visual concepts, layouts and assets for websites and digital content.
  • Prepare graphics for different formats and screen sizes.
  • Work with feedback to refine typography, composition and visual details.

What we’re looking for

  • A portfolio or examples that show your design thinking, including student or personal work.
  • Comfort with at least one digital design tool and an interest in learning new ones.
  • Care for visual clarity, consistency and collaboration.
Application details, work arrangement and compensation can be discussed directly.Apply by email ↗
